installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# playit.gg agent install script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
# The daemon is published as a container image with a static binary, so it is copied out of
# the image layers with the registry API.
set -eo pipefail
trap 'echo "Install failed at line ${LINENO}: ${BASH_COMMAND}"' ERR

apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl ca-certificates jq tar gzip

case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) ARCH=amd64 ;;
    aarch64) ARCH=arm64 ;;
    *) echo "Unsupported architecture $(uname -m)"; exit 1 ;;
esac

REPO=playit-cloud/playit-agent
TAG=${PLAYIT_VERSION:-latest}
REGISTRY=https://ghcr.io/v2/${REPO}
ACCEPT="application/vnd.oci.image.index.v1+json,application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.list.v2+json,application/vnd.oci.image.manifest.v1+json,application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.v2+json"
TOKEN=$(curl -fsSL "https://ghcr.io/token?scope=repository:${REPO}:pull" | jq -r .token)

registry_get() {
    curl -fsSL -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" -H "Accept: ${ACCEPT}" "$@"
}

echo "Resolving ghcr.io/${REPO}:${TAG} for linux/${ARCH}"
DIGEST=$(registry_get "${REGISTRY}/manifests/${TAG}" \
    | jq -r --arg arch "${ARCH}" '.manifests[] | select(.platform.os == "linux" and .platform.architecture == $arch) | .digest' | head -n1)
if [ -z "${DIGEST}" ]; then
    echo "No linux/${ARCH} image found for tag ${TAG}"
    exit 1
fi

ROOTFS=$(mktemp -d)
for layer in $(registry_get "${REGISTRY}/manifests/${DIGEST}" | jq -r '.layers[].digest'); do
    registry_get "${REGISTRY}/blobs/${layer}" | tar -xz -C "${ROOTFS}" --no-same-owner --exclude='dev/*' 2>/dev/null || true
done

if [ ! -f "${ROOTFS}/usr/local/bin/playitd" ]; then
    echo "playitd was not found in the image"
    exit 1
fi
install -m 755 "${ROOTFS}/usr/local/bin/playitd" /mnt/server/playitd
rm -rf "${ROOTFS}"

echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "playit agent installed"
echo "-----------------------------------------"
